label: prf:topological-mass-formula-algebraic
title: Proof of topological mass formula algebraic
html:
1. The pre-\tau object. By definition \mathrm{Vol}_q(\beta) = \mathrm{tr}_M(\beta). The cleared mass trace writes it as a polynomial in z = q^{3}/(q^{2}+1) with coefficients in \mathbb{Z}[h], h = q - q^{-1}. Since z and h lie in \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}][(q^{2}+1)^{-1}], so does \mathrm{Vol}_q(\beta). No absolute value, logarithm or limit is used at this stage.
  2. The specialisation. \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} evaluates this element at q = q_0, which is defined because q_0^{2} + 1 \neq 0. Only then are the archimedean operations applied: the absolute value and, since \mathrm{Vol}_{q_0}(\beta)\neq0 by hypothesis, the logarithm give \Phi_1(\beta) = \ln\lvert\mathrm{Vol}_{q_0}(\beta)\rvert, and dividing by \hbar_{q_0}^{2} gives \mathfrak{m}_{\mathrm{alg}}(\beta).

This proves the displayed identity, which is a definition of \mathfrak{m}_{\mathrm{alg}} together with the claim that its only pre-\tau input is algebraic. The tower terms \Phi_q(|\hat V_i|) of the unified knot mass formula are not used: they contain an absolute value and are themselves archimedean.

The identification of \Phi_1(\beta) with the hyperbolic volume \mathrm{Vol}(K) is not proved here. It is conditional on the volume conjecture and is recorded separately in Topological mass formula (Archimedean). \square
